acceptanceCriteria: A regression test runs affected with base == HEAD on a clean checkout of a multi-language fixture and pins a BOUNDED empty plan with no language-frontier unknowns and no mandatory full-suite advice.
Frontier unknowns are emitted only when a changed path reaches that frontier; a dirty worktree with an empty committed diff still reports its dirty paths as today.
AFP-V0 spec wording updated if the empty-diff result is newly specified; focused tests via heavy.sh.
body: Observed 2026-10-20 by two pre-1.0 bug lanes (bugs-affected-cmd, bugs-testsource) at lane start: `corvint affected --base 2b0cfce94` in a clean worktree whose HEAD equals the base (empty diff) returned scope UNKNOWN, listing ~23 LANGUAGE_FRONTIER entries (cfamily, dotnet, python, ruby, swift, typescript) plus NO_ADVISORY_GO_COMMAND, and advice that still lists `make gate`/the full test run. An empty diff has no changed path, so no frontier can be reached; the expected plan is a BOUNDED empty selection with no unknowns (or a single explicit EMPTY_DIFF note). Related but distinct: V1-0567 (dogfood empty range), V1-2070 (fast tier on BOUNDED empty selection over a non-empty diff).

title: corvint affected --base <HEAD> on a clean worktree (empty diff) returns scope UNKNOWN with ~23 language-frontier unknowns and a Go advice gap
